protocol.target: unchanged FI9 target (SWS Balance Luzon hunger > preceding-20-quarter normal + round MOE), Lead 1

evaluation_categories.B_previously_examined: targets 2018 onward (scored in FI7, FI8, FI9; NOT an untouched test)
evaluation_categories.C_prospective: forecasts registered before their outcome is published (data/fi9/out/prospective_register.jsonl)

protocol.current_model: C0 = FI9 damped persistence + training-only threshold tau (production)

candidates.C1_local_level: Kalman local-level filter of the published series with the published sampling variance as observation noise; state variance by maximum likelihood on training quarters; class by training-only tau (same inner-fold rule as C0)
candidates.C1b_damped_local_level: C1 filtered level, then damped toward the five-year normal (phi fitted on training)
candidates.C2_recalibrated_damped: C0 with Platt recalibration of its probability fitted on inner out-of-fold training predictions only; class unchanged
candidates.C3_<domain>: C0 level + ridge correction of its residual using one domain's indicators (market, climate, employment, remittance, poverty, news); alpha by inner CV on training; diagnostic of incremental value beyond persistence

baselines: FI9 LightGBM (saved FI9 predictions, same origins)

interval_methods.conformal: level +/- the finite-sample 95% quantile of inner out-of-fold absolute level errors (training only)

historical: passes the FI7 reliability rule on A+B (full) and on B
passes it without the FI7 sawtooth quarters
Brier better than C0 on full with block-bootstrap P(diff<0) >= 0.90
Brier better than naive persistence on full with P >= 0.90
not worse than C0 on B (mean Brier diff <= 0)
adoption_rule.interval: replace the gaussian interval only if its full-period 95% coverage is outside [0.90, 0.99] and the conformal interval's is inside
adoption_rule.status: an adopted candidate is still 'provisional' until prospective (C) evidence exists

diagnostics_not_for_adoption: design-aware adjustment of n=300 rounds (sample sizes known only from 2023)
release-date robustness: rule-based pre-2021 SWS release dates delayed by 30 days
